zenstory-ai-video-recap-skills-video-rec.description: General-purpose AI video editing and narration recap skill powered by minimal atomic CLIs (Python stdlib + ffmpeg/ffprobe) and a single canonical timeline.json. Supports multi-source cutting, multimodal frame inspection, local-first ASR/TTS (with optional remote HTTP ASR/TTS), multi-track ducking & loudness, subtitles, vertical packaging & SFX, JianYing draft export, review dashboard, and asset library. 通用视频剪辑与解说制作技能：用极简原子 CLI 与单一 timeline.json 完成多源剪辑、看图选镜、配音混音、字幕包装、物理质检及剪映导出。

zenstory-ai-video-recap-skills-video-ref.description: Analyze a finished reference video locally to extract shot rhythm, loudness/audio density, and contact sheets, then distill reusable editing and storytelling patterns into plain Markdown REFERENCE_NOTES.md without leaking source plot details. 按需拆解优秀成片：本地实测镜头节奏、响度密度并抽帧拼图，提炼脱敏的可迁移剪辑参考笔记 REFERENCE_NOTES.md。
